content.text:
I released **v0.37.1**: https://github.com/cv/pit/releases/tag/v0.37.1

- **What's in it:** the `[skill]` / `[skill ref]` lines from this PR (#394), plus #391. #391 makes results with an `outcome` field show it in the headline (e.g. `· outcome: pending`) and makes `npm.run` results name the script they ran.
- **Release PR #395:** bumped `package.json` and `package-lock.json` to 0.37.1, added the 0.37.1 entry to `CHANGELOG.md`, and pointed the pinned install command in the README at `v0.37.1`. Check, tests, coverage and package:check passed locally, and all 5 PR checks passed. I rebase-merged it into `main` as `17b78f6`.
- **Tag and publish:** CI passed on `17b78f6` on `main` before I tagged it as `v0.37.1`. The Release workflow then succeeded.
- **Checked after publishing:** the release points at the tagged commit and has no assets. A fresh clone of the tag installed its runtime dependencies and ran the sandbox (`1 + 1` returned `2`).

I didn't run the hands-on smoke test of the installed tag in a real Pi that `docs/releasing.md` lists after publishing; that still needs doing.

**Optional follow-up:** the pi Assistant workflow (`.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml`) still loads `github:cv/pit#v0.37.0`. After the last release this was bumped in its own commit, and since `main` is protected that would need another small PR. I can open it if you want.
